name: Jamie Lin
subject: Internship / Project Opportunities in machine learning and reinforcement learning for systematic trading strategies at TradeWave Capital | IIT Bombay
email_body:
Dear Jamie Lin,

I hope you are doing well.

My name is Jordan Rivera, a B.Tech. Computer Science student at Example Institute of Technology, where I hold a CPI of 9.5. I am writing to express my interest in TradeWave Capital's work in machine learning and reinforcement learning for systematic trading strategies, and to explore whether there might be a remote internship or project opportunity where I could contribute.

I have worked on related projects including a parameter-efficient fine-tuning project for language models and a biomedical deep learning classification project, which I believe are directly relevant to the work your team is doing.

I understand TradeWave Capital supports remote internships, and I wanted to ask if there might be a remote internship or project opportunity where I could contribute and learn.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your ongoing research remotely, and I am glad to work flexibly around whatever timing suits your group best.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.
